name: Music (ACE-Step XL)
description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo. Text to music, 30 seconds, 8 steps.
promptGuide: Write the style as short comma-separated tags: genre, mood, instruments, vocal type, tempo feel. Example: calm lo-fi piano, soft rain, warm, instrumental. For songs with singing, put the words in Lyrics with section tags like [verse] and [chorus]. For music with no singing, leave Lyrics as [instrumental].
